finding: 系统新规则明确比率ROUND2且优先于案例，参考与召回退款率案例为ROUND4。预测遵循新规则，不能将精度差异归为模型生成错误。

reference.question: 请统计整体退款率，输出结果。
reference.query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.refund_amount > 0 THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM ecommerce.orders o LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id;

predicted.query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.refund_amount > 0 THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS refund_rate FROM ecommerce.orders o LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id;

knowledge_in_actual_prompt.knowledge_text: 退款率（订单退款率/售后退款率）可按退款订单数占订单数计算。订单明细中退款金额超过0时，可认为发生退款。计算公式：COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN refund_amount > 0 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)。
